evals.prompt: Create product requirements for notifications. Supplied facts: delivery is required through both in-app and email channels; quiet-hours policy is unconfirmed. Product Owner is responsible for deciding quiet-hours policy. Return distinct rows using these field schemas: REQUIREMENT|<scope>|<supplied fact>|<status>|<owner>|<verification>; DECISION|<open question>|<status>|<owner>|required-input=<input>. Do not merge distinct requirements or decisions.
evals.expected_output:
Two confirmed channel records and one owned quiet-hours decision with required input.
REQUIREMENT|notification-delivery|in-app|CONFIRMED|Product Owner|in-app delivery confirmed
REQUIREMENT|notification-delivery|email|CONFIRMED|Product Owner|email delivery confirmed
DECISION|quiet-hours|UNRESOLVED|Product Owner|required-input=approved quiet-hours policy

evals.prompt: Draft product requirements for checkout performance. Supplied approved evidence: current baseline P95 latency is 1.2 seconds. The target latency SLA has not been decided. Product Owner supplies the approved target SLA. evals.expected_output:
Keep 1.2 seconds as the approved P95 baseline; keep the target SLA unresolved with an owner and required input.
BASELINE|checkout-latency|1.2|seconds|P95|APPROVED
TARGET|checkout-latency|UNRESOLVED|Product Owner|required-input=approved target SLA

evals.prompt: Draft product requirements for payment checkout. Supplied facts: payment provider is Stripe; supported currencies are USD and EUR; 3DS authentication is mandatory before payment authorization. The guest-checkout policy is undecided and Product Owner owns that decision. Return distinct rows using only these neutral schemas: FACT|<scope>|<attribute>|<supplied value>|<status>; RULE|<condition>|<required consequence>|<verification>; OUTCOME|<condition result>|<authorization consequence>|<completion consequence>; DECISION|<open question>|<status>|<owner>|required-input=<input>. Describe outcomes of successful and failed 3DS results in relation to payment authorization and checkout completion.
evals.expected_output:
Preserve Stripe, USD and EUR, and mandatory 3DS before authorization. Successful 3DS may allow authorization to proceed subject to the payment result; failed 3DS must not authorize payment. Keep guest checkout unresolved with Product Owner and required input.
FACT|payment checkout|provider|Stripe|CONFIRMED
FACT|payment checkout|supported currency|USD|CONFIRMED
FACT|payment checkout|supported currency|EUR|CONFIRMED
RULE|3DS authentication|required before payment authorization|mandatory 3DS required
OUTCOME|3DS passed|authorization may proceed|payment outcome still determines completion
OUTCOME|3DS failed|payment authorization not granted|checkout does not complete
DECISION|guest checkout|UNRESOLVED|Product Owner|required-input=approved guest-checkout policy

assertions.value: (?:^|\r?\n)OUTCOME\|3DS passed\|authorization may proceed\|payment outcome still determines completion(?:\r?\n|$)
(?:^|\r?\n)OUTCOME\|3DS failed\|payment authorization not granted\|checkout does not complete(?:\r?\n|$)

REQUIREMENT|validation ownership|MISSING|named validation owner
REQUIREMENT|behavioral acceptance criteria|MISSING|approved observable criteria

evals.prompt: Review product scope completeness and capability boundaries for loan management. Supplied facts: approved Release 1.0 scope commitments include loan application intake, collateral appraisal, fund disbursement, and payment collection; borrower accounts may incur late payments or default after the payment due date; Product Owner is responsible for decisions on uncommitted capability scope. Return distinct records with no padding around | using: CAPABILITY|<capability>|<disposition>|<status>, and DECISION|<uncommitted capability>|<status>|<owner>|required-input=<input>. Permitted disposition values: IN_SCOPE, DEFERRED, EXCLUDED. Permitted decision status values: RESOLVED, UNRESOLVED. Do not invent release commitments or silently omit uncommitted capabilities.

Classify each approved committed capability as IN_SCOPE and identify uncommitted overdue loan handling as an UNRESOLVED scope decision for Product Owner disposition; do not invent an in-scope status for overdue handling.
CAPABILITY|loan application intake|IN_SCOPE|CONFIRMED
CAPABILITY|collateral appraisal|IN_SCOPE|CONFIRMED
CAPABILITY|fund disbursement|IN_SCOPE|CONFIRMED
CAPABILITY|payment collection|IN_SCOPE|CONFIRMED
DECISION|overdue loan handling|UNRESOLVED|Product Owner|required-input=in_scope disposition required
